test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The king's **gules **hegemonised the family coat of arms.

options.text: The exorbitant hall featured gules and argent prominently.
The cook prepared a sauce of deep gules and cumin.
The gules border symbolised martial lineage.
The hermit explained the symbolism of gules to the followers.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **The cook prepared a sauce of deep gules and cumin.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **“gules”** in heraldry means the color **red**, especially a deep red color used on coats of arms. (लाल रंग)

 
 
• **Example:** The family crest displayed a lion on a field of gules, representing bravery and valor.
 
 
 
• In the correct option, **“gules”** is used as a homonym referring to **“gul”** (a word that sounds similar but is unrelated in meaning). It humorously implies a deep red sauce, showing the use of “gules” as a color reference outside heraldry. (सॉस का लाल रंग)
 
 
• **Example:** The chef added paprika to give the dish a gules hue that made it look appetizing.
 
 
 
• Hence, the sentence that contains the homonymic use of the word “gules” is Option 2.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **The cook prepared a sauce of deep gules and cumin.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** “The exorbitant hall featured gules and argent prominently.” – Correctly uses “gules” in the heraldic sense (लाल रंग), not as a homonym.

 
 
• **Example:** The knight’s banner was divided into gules and argent.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “The gules border symbolised martial lineage.” – Again, “gules” is used in its original heraldic sense, meaning red (लाल रंग).
 
 
• **Example:** The shield with a gules border denoted courage.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** “The hermit explained the symbolism of gules to the followers.” – Refers to heraldic symbolism (लाल रंग का प्रतीक), not a homonym.
 
 
• **Example:** The hermit taught that gules symbolises bravery and sacrifice.
